summary: Second confirmation of THE Room, at head 8467f01 against the confirmed head 1430d42. The score holds at 8.5. git diff --stat 1430d42..HEAD over src/ and tex/ touches only 04_shaders.js, 12_scene.js and 4 lines of 07_shell.js (the window roll-in lip now uses the sidewall albedo). 09c_room.js, 09_seats.js, 03_tex.js and tex/ are unchanged. Every room-only calibration region is identical to the RGB unit: q09 privacy wall #33353e, q06 near shell #3c3d47, q06 door #a8a7a4, q06 cabinet ash #a39784, q07 ash #aca08c, q08 header band #5f6674, q06 base #403636, q09 cap 108/111/119, q08 flap 109/116/130, q08 carpet 66/55/55. Frame-level pixel changes (>6 levels) cover 3.5-4.4 % of q06/q09/q10, all in the upper or far window belt, and 14-16 % of q07/q08, on the window wall, the window tubs and the 11A window-side post. The routed lighting item is fixed: in q07 the window-side post next to the 11A monitor went from #454854 (L73) to #5c6273 (L98), against c_27316 at #6b6e7c (L111). That is within about 12 % of the photo, up from 34 % short. Rater B's cool-belt item is also fixed: the q08 window pier B-R went from +23 to +15, the tub lip from +13 to +5 and the q07 sidewall from +9 to +2. The official photos sit at -1 to +11. No room part regressed, and the 2x crops show no new artefact. The carried lows are all still open and unchanged: short kick with no silver lip, ash pinstripe, header band ~10 % dark, rigid pillows, faint grain on the post. Product read: clearly the same product, with minor material and lighting differences.

score_vs_final.why: Room geometry, materials and textures are byte-unchanged, and every room calibration region is identical. The two routed lighting items both moved toward the photos: the q07 post went from L73 to L98 (photo 111), and the window belt cool cast went from B-R +23 to +15 on the q08 pier and from +9 to +2 on the q07 wall. Nothing regressed. That is a small gain on the window side of the J seats, but not enough to lift the area above 8.5, because the carried material lows (kick, ash, soft goods, grain) are still open.
